source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

steps.text: Prepare your family's Emergency Go Bag containing items needed for survival.

source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

steps.text: Participate in office and community earthquake drills.

source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

sections.title: During shaking: Duck, Cover and Hold

steps.text: When inside a building: "Duck, Cover, and Hold". Duck under a strong table and hold on to it.

source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

steps.text: Stay away from glass windows, shelves and heavy objects.

source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

steps.text: After the shaking stops, exit the building, and go to the designated evacuation area.

source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

steps.text: If outside, move to an open area, away from buildings, trees, electric posts and landslide prone areas.

source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

steps.text: If you're in a moving vehicle, stop and exit the vehicle.

source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake
Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

steps.text: If in a coastal area and there is a threat of a tsunami, evacuate to higher ground immediately.

source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

steps.text: Stay out of the building until advised that it is safe to return.

source.label: Quezon City: What to do during an earthquake

steps.text: Avoid contact with floodwaters; they can contain chemicals, sewage and debris.
